module|addon/wavelength/source/asset_bro.name: asset_browser
module|addon/wavelength/source/asset_bro.description: Native Asset Browser publishers using existing WAD/VPK/FGD backends.

module|addon/wavelength/source/asset_ind.name: asset_index
module|addon/wavelength/source/asset_ind.description: Local, incremental engine asset metadata. No game data enters releases.

module|addon/wavelength/source/asset_loa.name: asset_loading
module|addon/wavelength/source/asset_loa.description: Progressive map previews: pure decoding off-process, Blender data on the UI thread.

module|addon/wavelength/source/asset_pla.name: asset_placement
module|addon/wavelength/source/asset_pla.description: Click-to-paint surfaces and click-to-place entities from the native browser.

module|addon/wavelength/source/asset_run.name: asset_runtime_worker
module|addon/wavelength/source/asset_run.description: Decode requested map assets in a separate Blender process, without scene edits.

module|addon/wavelength/source/asset_sea.name: asset_search
module|addon/wavelength/source/asset_sea.description: Debounce the native texture filter without replacing Blender's browser.

module|addon/wavelength/source/authoring.name: authoring
module|addon/wavelength/source/authoring.description:
High-level engine authoring workflows for Wavelength 0.10 pre-alpha.

These operators deliberately compose the existing brush/entity/texture/export systems.
They do not replace the canonical geometry, grid, transform or MAP paths.

module|addon/wavelength/source/axis_guid.name: axis_guides
module|addon/wavelength/source/axis_guid.description: Temporary world-axis guides shared by keyboard and gizmo transforms.

module|addon/wavelength/source/brush_cre.name: brush_create
module|addon/wavelength/source/brush_cre.description:
Profile-aware interactive cube/brush creation.

All profiles expose the same click-click prototyping interaction. Blender mode snaps
to Blender's viewport grid and creates an ordinary mesh; engine profiles snap to
their profile grid and create brush-tagged meshes.

module|addon/wavelength/source/bsp_decom.name: bsp_decompose
module|addon/wavelength/source/bsp_decom.description:
Bounded, exact-plane convex partition of closed Boolean meshes.

Partition the bounding solid by the input face planes, then retain cells whose
centres lie inside the oriented input surface. No voxelization or grid rounding:
the surface planes survive conversion. This deliberately favours correctness
over brush count; complex assets should use the model pipeline instead.

module|addon/wavelength/source/build/pip.name: pipeline
module|addon/wavelength/source/build/pip.description: Polled subprocess pipeline; no Blender API and no shell command strings.

module|addon/wavelength/source/build/too.name: toolchains
module|addon/wavelength/source/build/too.description: Resolve supported compiler names without assuming Windows executable suffixes.

module|addon/wavelength/source/civ5_cell.name: civ5_cells
module|addon/wavelength/source/civ5_cell.description: High-level hex-cell authoring; Blender mesh geometry is only a visualization.

module|addon/wavelength/source/civ5_form.name: civ5_format
module|addon/wavelength/source/civ5_form.description: Lossless Civ V geography edits; unknown/scenario bytes stay opaque.

module|addon/wavelength/source/context_p.name: context_policy
module|addon/wavelength/source/context_p.description: Context capabilities and object meaning; independent of Blender execution.

module|addon/wavelength/source/context_s.name: context_state
module|addon/wavelength/source/context_s.description: Scene context transitions, reversible helper visibility and clean render hooks.

module|addon/wavelength/source/cross_com.name: cross_compile
module|addon/wavelength/source/cross_com.description:
Cross-profile conversion contract and conservative, explicit backend registry.

Conversion never edits the authoring scene. Unknown entities/properties stay in
the conversion report rather than silently being treated as compatible.

module|addon/wavelength/source/csg.py|cs.name: csg
module|addon/wavelength/source/csg.py|cs.description: Editable node Booleans and transactional, profile-owned BSP finalization.

module|addon/wavelength/source/custom_mo.name: custom_models
module|addon/wavelength/source/custom_mo.description: Editable custom Source models owned by map entities and built as dependencies.

module|addon/wavelength/source/cutter_sn.name: cutter_snap
module|addon/wavelength/source/cutter_sn.description: Screen-radius geometry targeting and surface-oriented placement cursor.

module|addon/wavelength/source/cutter_so.name: cutter_solid
module|addon/wavelength/source/cutter_so.description: Capped solid operations from a planar cutter path.

module|addon/wavelength/source/diagnosti.name: diagnostics
module|addon/wavelength/source/diagnosti.description: Persistent, bounded add-on diagnostics and CLI/error log; imports without Blender.

module|addon/wavelength/source/diagnosti.name: diagnostics_ui
module|addon/wavelength/source/diagnosti.description: Blender-only controls for inspecting and sharing add-on diagnostics.

module|addon/wavelength/source/displacem.name: displacement
module|addon/wavelength/source/displacem.description:
Source displacement data and geometry, independent of Blender.

Rows follow Valve's start-corner ordering: columns run along corner 0 -> 3,
rows along 0 -> 1 in Source's clockwise winding (CCW in our mesh adapter).

module|addon/wavelength/source/distribut.name: distribution
module|addon/wavelength/source/distribut.description:
Deterministic distribution candidates. No Blender or engine dependencies.

Stable cell addresses make paint/density edits local. Mesh surface projection,
mask evaluation and preview are adapters, not sources of placement identity.

module|addon/wavelength/source/draw_disp.name: draw_displacement
module|addon/wavelength/source/draw_disp.description: Export structured drawing grids as exact Source displacement brush faces.

module|addon/wavelength/source/draw_geom.name: draw_geometry
module|addon/wavelength/source/draw_geom.description: Curve sampling and outline validation independent of Blender.

module|addon/wavelength/source/edit_safe.name: edit_safety
module|addon/wavelength/source/edit_safe.description: Keep background edit-mesh access outside native topology transactions.

module|addon/wavelength/source/editor.py.name: editor
module|addon/wavelength/source/editor.py.description: Reusable editing operations for convex brushes and engine texture previews.

module|addon/wavelength/source/engine_to.name: engine_tools
module|addon/wavelength/source/engine_to.description: Workspace-scoped engine tool column and undoable grid transforms.

module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/__.description: Entity catalogs, editor representations, and the Wavelength Asset Browser.

module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/br.name: browser
module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/br.description:
Wavelength Asset Browser backed by Blender's native Asset Browser.

Python add-ons cannot register a new Blender Space type.  We therefore publish
active-profile entity templates as Current File assets.  Blender supplies the
thumbnail/name tile UI and native drag from the Asset Browser into a 3D View.
A depsgraph finalizer turns dropped templates into normal Wavelength entities.

module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/fg.name: fgd
module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/fg.description: Read common FGD classes/properties without evaluating FGD content as code.

module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/go.name: goldsrc
module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/go.description:
Built-in Half-Life/GoldSrc entity property fallback.

This is intentionally a pragmatic authoring catalog, not a replacement for a
mod's FGD. Loaded FGD data wins; these definitions fill missing inherited or
stock HL1 fields so the UI remains useful out of the box.

module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/ic.name: icons
module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/ic.description:
Editor-only, screen-facing SVG sprites for abstract point entities.

The Wavelength HL1 icon pack is parsed directly.  Do not depend on Blender's
optional SVG import extension: viewport icons are drawn as flat 2D artwork.

module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/in.name: interaction
module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/in.description: Treat an entity and its editor representation as one selectable/movable unit.

module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/mo.name: models
module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/mo.description: Editor-only GoldSrc glTF and Source studio-model entity references.

module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/so.name: source_schema
module|addon/wavelength/source/entity/so.description: Use the selected game's installed Hammer schema, never a Source-wide union.

module|addon/wavelength/source/environme.name: environment_adopt
module|addon/wavelength/source/environme.description: Adopt existing native point-instance sets without flattening or losing the remainder.

module|addon/wavelength/source/environme.name: environment_godot
module|addon/wavelength/source/environme.description:
Godot environment bundle adapter. Runtime policy stays in the game.

GLBs contain terrain modules and shared prototypes, never flattened forests.
Schema-1 JSON retains masks, rules, IDs, overrides and Y-up instance matrices.

module|addon/wavelength/source/environme.name: environment_layers
module|addon/wavelength/source/environme.description:
Authored terrain masks, deterministic rules, shared instances and overrides.

Schema 1 lives in native mesh vertex groups and Object RNA layer records. Generated
point geometry is disposable. No depsgraph handlers or whole-world rescatters.

module|addon/wavelength/source/environme.name: environment_materials
module|addon/wavelength/source/environme.description:
Independent live native paint attributes and shader composition.

Privateer's six-biome palette is an explicit material adapter, not engine policy.

module|addon/wavelength/source/export_sc.name: export_scope
module|addon/wavelength/source/export_sc.description: One inclusion policy for native Outliner flags, engine trees and exporters.

module|addon/wavelength/source/external_.name: external_library
module|addon/wavelength/source/external_.description: Native external asset-library integration; no catalog materials in the map.

module|addon/wavelength/source/fence_rou.name: fence_route
module|addon/wavelength/source/fence_rou.description: Stage fence posts along an open Blender Poly spline.

module|addon/wavelength/source/formats.p.name: formats
module|addon/wavelength/source/formats.p.description: Bounded classic/Valve 220 MAP reader and deterministic writer.

module|addon/wavelength/source/geometry..name: geometry
module|addon/wavelength/source/geometry..description:
Convex-brush geometry, independent of Blender.

All coordinates in this experiment use one Blender unit per engine unit.
This is not an engine profile or a complete MAP importer.

module|addon/wavelength/source/geometry_.name: geometry_debug
module|addon/wavelength/source/geometry_.description: Viewport mesh diagnostics: explicit scans, automatic failure capture and live repair feedback.

module|addon/wavelength/source/geometry_.name: geometry_diagnostics
module|addon/wavelength/source/geometry_.description: Locate the mesh elements responsible for the convex validator's first error.

module|addon/wavelength/source/goldsrc_i.name: goldsrc_import
module|addon/wavelength/source/goldsrc_i.description: GoldSrc entity model resolution and shared Blender geometry/materials.

module|addon/wavelength/source/goldsrc_m.name: goldsrc_model
module|addon/wavelength/source/goldsrc_m.description: Bounded GoldSrc MDL v10 decoding, using installed game/mod assets directly.

module|addon/wavelength/source/goldsrc_t.name: goldsrc_tools
module|addon/wavelength/source/goldsrc_t.description: Discover Windows Half-Life assets and an existing compatible GoldSrc toolchain.

module|addon/wavelength/source/grid.py|g.name: grid
module|addon/wavelength/source/grid.py|g.description:
Native grid state bridge. Python never submits grid geometry or GPU shaders.

The patched Blender renderer owns plane intersection, coverage, native depth and
compositing. This module only supplies per-viewport settings and restores them.

module|addon/wavelength/source/identity..name: identity
module|addon/wavelength/source/identity..description: Assign object identities after native Blender duplication, without changing mesh data.

module|addon/wavelength/source/keyvalues.name: keyvalues
module|addon/wavelength/source/keyvalues.description: Bounded Valve KeyValues text parser; retains order and repeated keys.

module|addon/wavelength/source/landing_s.name: landing_stairs
module|addon/wavelength/source/landing_s.description: Fit a procedural straight stair to two world-space landing connections.

module|addon/wavelength/source/launcher..name: launcher
module|addon/wavelength/source/launcher..description: Locate the Steam client without requiring Windows users to edit PATH.

module|addon/wavelength/source/library_p.name: library_prepare_worker
module|addon/wavelength/source/library_p.description: Profile indexing and incremental thumbnail preparation outside the editor.

module|addon/wavelength/source/library_w.name: library_worker
module|addon/wavelength/source/library_w.description: Isolated Blender process: build preview-only external material libraries.

module|addon/wavelength/source/map_impor.name: map_import_worker
module|addon/wavelength/source/map_impor.description: Parse/validate map files off-process; stream bounded brush records to the UI.

module|addon/wavelength/source/map_prepa.name: map_prepare
module|addon/wavelength/source/map_prepa.description: Pure map validation and geometry preparation, safe in an isolated worker.

module|addon/wavelength/source/measureme.name: measurements
module|addon/wavelength/source/measureme.description:
Live Edit Mode edge dimensions in the active profile's display units.

Read the edit BMesh, not the last committed mesh datablock. Draw only screen-space
text; this never changes Blender's mesh, unit settings, or built-in overlays.

module|addon/wavelength/source/mesh_asse.name: mesh_assets
module|addon/wavelength/source/mesh_asse.description:
Static mesh/texture handoff for mesh engines, isolated from BSP and entities.

Evaluate into a temporary scene, bake world transforms and normalize physical
units there. Never apply modifiers, rewrite shaders or change selection in the
authoring scene. Completed bundles contain only meshes, materials and images.

boundary while the opposite boundary remains fixed.  The dragged boundary is
snapped using the active grid when grid snapping is enabled.

not redistributed with the addon. Original material paths survive preview and
map export; a viewport approximation never replaces the engine's shader.

indices. UVs belong to half-edge corners, not shared mesh vertices. This module
has no Blender dependency so malformed input can be rejected before allocation.

module|addon/wavelength/source/source2_m.description:
Static editable Source 2 VMAP meshes with CS2 material references.

are adapted separately; unsupported data is retained in a conversion report.

module|addon/wavelength/source/source_di.description:
Editable Source displacement surfaces attached to their original brush faces.

positions, blend values and triangle attributes. Neither is regenerated on edit.

module|addon/wavelength/source/source_po.description: Source QAngle poses: Rz(yaw) @ Ry(pitch) @ Rx(roll), in map axes.

space. The regular Properties editor and artist-owned Collections stay intact.

bound to both the original and resulting executable; --force cannot waive either.

string is replaced once, even when it contains both shader stages.

perform injection. A journal and original backup support recovery and removal.

may be absent because Blender embeds or transforms shader sources at build time.
